Linaceae.key_door: local Linum: 5 free petals + 5 stamens + 5 styles + many-part capsule

Salicaceae.key_door: dioecious catkins + 1-locular parietal ovary + valved capsule with comose seeds

Violaceae.key_door: stipules + 5 close-set stamens/anther connectives + 1-locular parietal ovary + 3-valved capsule

Hypericaceae.key_door: opposite exstipulate gland-dotted leaves + 5 yellow petals + numerous bundled stamens

Phyllanthaceae.key_door: phyllanthoid branching + tiny unisexual flowers + 2 ovules per locule + no latex

anchor_families.Euphorbiaceae: 3-locular ovary with one ovule per locule; often latex; columella fruit
anchor_families.Malpighiaceae: opposite leaves + clawed petals + often sepal oil glands

lineage_lesson: Malpighiales is too diverse for one gestalt. Teach each family by a high-value reproductive mechanism, then use the shared order only to organize comparisons.
taxonomy_notes: Pombalia verticillata is accepted; older Hybanthus verticillatus remains a useful source-name cross-reference.
Populus deltoides subsp. deltoides is accepted under current Kew and should not be flattened into an unrelated species concept.
Hypericum hypericoides and H. walteri are accepted under current Kew.
Phyllanthus urinaria is accepted but introduced in Texas; retain it as an introduced comparison, not a native anchor.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Species nativity/range judgments remain in species lanes.
Do not rebuild Euphorbiaceae, Malpighiaceae, or Passifloraceae; use them only as comparison anchors.
